heading.title: First Division · Part I · Suits Relating to Accounts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article2Three years.



The Schedule · First Division—Suits · Part I—Suits Relating to Accounts



Against a factor for an account.


Period of limitation
Three years.



Time from which period begins to run
When the account is, during the continuance of the agency, demanded and refused or, where no such
                demand is made, when the agency terminates.
